propositions: Checkbox-state normalization (case-insensitive x, -, or * bullets normalized to '[ ]' pre-hash) in commit 330c prevents box flips from staling attestations, but docs/plan-review-gate.md still describes old behavior where any description edit invalidates.
The invalidation rules in docs/plan-review-gate.md (~L469) must be updated to explicitly state that checkbox-state flips are NOT material and do not invalidate attestations; only item-text edits do.
The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (~L901) must document that satisfying the precheck by checking boxes does not invalidate the plan-review attestation.
Other documentation (user-guide.md, completion-verifier docs) may incorrectly claim box flips stale a review and must be audited and corrected for consistency.
